title: Self-Pay Package Portal Bookings — Appointment Series Patient Terms
content:
Patient portal terms for booking standing appointments online on an Appointment Series paid for by a Self-Pay Visit Package.

**Definition.** A package portal booking is the batch of standing appointments a patient books for themselves through the patient portal on an appointment series funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package. These terms govern the number of appointments such a booking opens.

**Settlement of the number.**

(a) The number of appointments a package portal booking opens is fixed only after a no-show on the series' first appointment within its fee assessment period carries its first-appointment no-show fee entry.

(b) A package portal booking is not opened until every late arrival beyond the grace period recorded on the series as a zero-notice cancellation within its fee assessment period shows a late-arrival fee entry.

(c) The package portal booking count is fixed only after every same-day cancellation recorded on the series within its fee assessment period carries its same-day cancellation fee entry.

**The portal action — `book_package_portal_visits_336412d0`.** It books, as the patient in the patient portal, a batch of standing appointments on the patient's own appointment series that the Self-Pay Visit Package pays for. One run books the stated number of consecutive standing appointments starting on the chosen date, adds them to the appointments still booked on the series and records the booking as made through the portal; the patient sees the new appointments on their schedule.

It is a customer-run tool: the representative unlocks `book_package_portal_visits_336412d0` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the patient, in the patient portal — runs it.

Parameters:

- `series_id` — text identifier: the reference number of the patient's appointment series, as read out to the patient by the patient services representative from the appointment series lookup.
- `appointment_date` — YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, clinic local time): the date of the earliest appointment of the new batch, falling on one of the series' standing weekdays.
- `visits` — a non-negative integer (visits): how many standing appointments to book in this batch, as told to the patient by the representative.

Return on success: `booking_reference` (the reference number of the new booking; its presence means the appointments were booked), `series_id` (the series the appointments were added to), `first_appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the earliest appointment booked), `visits_booked` (the number of appointments booked), `booking_channel` (always `patient_portal`) and `booked_visits_remaining` (the appointments now booked and not yet attended on the series). No other return or error is defined.
